description: Fixed visual audit for first-room production dwarf-miner animation Frames.
occlusion_rule: An identity feature may disappear only when the pose clearly occludes it; do not add a feature through an arm, hand, tool, or turned-away surface.

fixed_questions.question: Are short/broad proportions, beard mass, the oversized blue lamp helmet, green clothing, belt and buckle, gloves, boots, and pickaxe legible and temporally consistent whenever the pose exposes them?
Does the machine-readable check report show automatic Identity Lock PASS for every Frame before you judge exposed identity outside the locked regions?
When the eye is exposed, is it a single black Cell with no white sclera?
At native scale, are face/beard, beard/torso, hands/handle, legs/torso, and boots/ground separated rather than accidentally melding at same-value contacts?
Do Master Palette roles, upper-left local light, and selective warm-dark outline remain stable across Frames?
Do identity accents and intentional outlines remain stable across Frames without one-Frame decorative flicker?

walk.question: Do the alternating legs remain separable from each other and from the torso throughout the loop?
Does the torso keep a stable silhouette and readable upper-body mass throughout the loop?

swing.question: Does the swing sequence show readable anticipation before the strike?
Does the pickaxe preserve a clear, continuous action arc across the one-shot sequence?
Is the gripping hand distinguishable from the pickaxe handle at native scale?
Do the boots read as planted and stable through the swing?
At Frame 3, is mining contact readable without losing hand, tool, or boot separation?

editing_rules: Use the fewest changed Cells that resolves the observed defect.
Use only colors already allowed by the combined Draft palette.
Never change alpha, baseline, dimensions, Frame order, or silhouette.
Prefer restoring an identity feature or separating forms over adding decorative detail.
Never override an automatic Identity Lock FAIL with a visual PASS.
Return UNCERTAIN instead of inventing intent when the profile and pose do not settle the edit.
audit_workflow: Walk and swing use two different PNGs: edit source = assets/first-room/dwarf/idle/provider/source.png (generation canvas); identity anchor = assets/first-room/dwarf/identity.png (16x24 lock evidence only).

Run strip:polish seed: npm run strip:polish -- seed --identity-declaration assets/first-room/dwarf/identity.json --out <seed.png>. This copies idle/provider/source.png byte-for-byte; it does NOT read or upscale identity.png.
Submit <seed.png> to the provider as the image-edit base (the image being edited). Do not generate a new image from the prompt alone. Do not use identity.png as the edit canvas.
On strip:polish init, pass --edit-source <seed.png> and --identity-reference assets/first-room/dwarf/identity.png.

Record identity.json generation_source.sha256 as edit_source_sha256 in each image-edit Attempt provenance. That digest must equal 655b8ff6a560d0e36ac008872d37239e33e25e51d70e77f4201ac2d1ca043ad3 while idle/provider/source.png is the declared generation source; any other digest fails with edit_source_not_generation_source.
Do not use fresh text-to-image generation for walk or swing.

Keep the subject (including pickaxe arc) inside a safe empty magenta inset so the bounding box does not touch provider canvas edges. Touching a canvas edge triggers provider_clipping — regenerate with margin guidance rather than post-editing the provider transport raster.

Generate sequential immutable Attempts until provenance, automatic Identity Lock, coherence, and polish pass on the unmodified provider transport raster. Do not script- or hand-edit provider/source.png after generation to clear Gates.

Forbidden provider post-edits include: wiping near-magenta to exact #FF00FF, shifting Frames for baseline, and painting or stamping Identity Lock / flat identity colors into pitch sample centers or locked regions.
A failed Identity Lock, baseline, clipping, or pitch check requires another Attempt — never provider painting. Only permitted post-ingest Polished Cell edits are allowed after ingest.
Record every rejection and predecessor edge in provider/attempts.json; do not cap Attempt count with a fixed quota.

When rejecting for Identity Lock, set rejection_reason to identity_lock and record rejection_detail from the machine-readable check report (schema identity-lock-near-miss/0) so near-miss Attempts remain auditable.
Run Identity Lock only after provider recovery produces logical Frames; read that machine-readable check report before opening art and confirm automatic PASS.
Inspect one composite or animation preview at native scale and enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling beside identity.png, the idle provider Strip, and idle Release Frames.

Reject art that reads as an upscaled or tiled identity.png rather than an edit of idle-provider outline, shading, helmet lamp, and tool construction. Also reject hard flat Identity Lock stamps or seams where painted lock Cells meet softer generated shading. Identity Lock PASS alone does not satisfy the audit when the edit source was not the idle provider Strip or when lock Cells were painted into the provider raster after generation.
Answer every fixed question and every applicable Motion-class override.
Apply the fewest permitted Cell edits for EDIT verdicts.
Re-render the preview and run strip:polish check.
Report every UNCERTAIN verdict and do not finalize until it is resolved.
